# SUNLIT RAINDROPS: a sheet of 250 parallel white lasers (a "sun" shining in
# from the left) hits one big raindrop and two small ones. Rays that go in,
# bounce once off the back and come out pile up at the rainbow angle (~42 deg),
# and the drop focuses the rest into a sharp caustic cusp behind it.
# With a wavelength-dependent refractive index this is literally how a
# rainbow forms; try dispersion .02 - .05.
